privacyModal.title: Statement on Collection and Use of Personal Information
privacyModal.mandatory: By clicking the "Agree" button, you agree to the Statement on Collection and Use of Personal Information (see below) for <0>AWS Code of Conduct</0>
privacyModal.description: It does not modify or supersede any of the terms of the <0>AWS Privacy Notice</0>
privacyModal.instruction: Do not provide any personal information, for example, full name, email address, phone number.
privacyModal.collectedItemDesc: Voice and conversation transcript at AWS summit 2026
privacyModal.collectionUsePurposeDesc: Voice input will be transcribed by Amazon Nova Sonic (Amazon's speech to speech foundation model). The conversation transcript will be processed by Generative AI models on Amazon Bedrock.
privacyModal.retentionPeriodDesc: Voice data will be deleted immediately upon processing. The transcript will be deleted at the end AWS Summit 2026.
